title: Three binary words that cannot be cyclically equalized: the shortest obstructions to simultaneous cyclic equalizability
description: The binary words 0110, 0101, 1001 have equal Hamming weight but cannot be made cyclically equal by common insertions of any length, answering negatively the three-word question of Shinagawa and Nuida (FCT 2025) and Fici (WORDS 2025). Includes a classification of all twenty length-four weight-two triples (exactly four fail, one symmetry class), minimality of length four, criteria at prescribed geometry, and a denominator bound. Formalized in Lean 4.33.0. Developed with the AI system Astra 6.2 under the author's direction; see the manuscript for the contribution statement. Not yet peer reviewed.
